runContextPanel.missingMeaning: Missing measurements mean unknown, not zero. Usage totals cover recorded attempts; they do not measure result quality.

runContextPanel.skipped: {count} learning exclusion event(s) recorded. See their reasons in the event history.
runContextPanel.status.failed: Run failed — review the reason and any partial work below.
runContextPanel.status.queued: Queued — waiting for execution capacity or earlier work.
runContextPanel.status.running: Working — the bot is executing this attempt.
runContextPanel.status.silent: Run ended without a reply — this does not confirm task completion.
runContextPanel.status.stopped: Run stopped — partial work is retained when available.
runContextPanel.status.succeeded: Run finished — review its result to confirm the task was delivered.
runContextPanel.status.waitingApproval: Paused for approval — the session is saved.
runContextPanel.status.waitingApprovalLi: Waiting for an approval while the attempt remains open.
runContextPanel.status.waitingContinuati: Turn limit reached — review partial work, then continue or stop.

runEventRow.ruleFile.shared: This is a shared-file observation; review the affected bot's canonical configuration.
